objective: Trace lot consumption and machine state on one batching area
boundary: one area/two controllers; no network modification

claims.statement: An operator interview reports manual lot entry and daily reconciliation.
A supplied inventory lists two controllers and no audited tag list.
Process note describes daily order CSV and manual record keeping.
Shift statement reports verbal post-cleaning release.
Whether machine state can be retrieved reliably with accurate timing is not established.
Lot genealogy may have reconciliation delay and transcription risk.

as_is_flow: Operator reportedly records consumed lots on paper [A-E1]

authority_gaps.question: Who is authorised to correct a paper lot entry after reconciliation?
Who authorises a return to production and where is that evidenced?

unknowns.question: What tags, protocols and timestamps actually exist on each controller?
What is the accepted lot reconciliation/override rule?
